description: Defines enums and classes related to icon states, activity kinds, and tool states for a macOS application, including visual badge representations and icon state transitions.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the symbol name for the badge based on the current activity.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge, if applicable.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the icon state represents a working activity.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to a corresponding icon state.
